name: @sure/api-tests
description: End-to-end API tests: drive the real backend binary through the generated @sure/client.
//openapi-fetch: Must stay identical to packages/client's range; see the note there for the tuple caveat that still applies to 0.17. fixtures.ts imports the client by relative path (`../client/src/index`), so the copy that decides response types is the client's. Keeping the two ranges equal is what keeps a single openapi-fetch in the tree.
//@types/node: Tracks the Node major this repo runs, not npm `latest`. `engines.node` is ">=24" and every workflow in .github pins `node-version: 24`, so ^24 types against the runtime CI actually uses; `latest` is 26.x, which would let code typecheck against APIs Node 24 does not have. 24.19.2 is the newest 24.x (2026-10-30). Raise this together with the Node pin, not on its own.
